summary: Full pre-production regression of (1) POST /api/transactions withdraw gate behind partial_withdraw_unlocked, (2) MT5Page + MT5HubSections refactor, (3) E2E smoke of the platform. Backend gate verified via 5 programmatic pytest cases (lock/over-cap/under-cap EUR + USD conversion paths). Frontend regression via Playwright: withdraw-unlock-indicator chip correctly shows 'Límite por retiro: €30.194,00 · 40% desbloqueado', partial-unlock-panel renders, all 7 MT5 Trading Suite tabs + 8 Hub sections render post-refactor, Reserve modal opens from new file via re-export, admin /admin/partial-unlock queue + /admin/mt5-invest pages load.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: <span> inside <tbody> and <tr> inside <span>. Not caused by this refactor (likely unrelated table structure in a nested section). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up eventually.

action_items: Optional: investigate React hydration warning on MT5Page (<span> child of <tbody>) — pre-existing, not caused by this iteration's refactor but flagged for next cleanup sprint.
critical_code_review_comments: transactions.py:71-90 gate implementation is clean: KYC check → unlock flag check → cap check (with USD→EUR conversion via EXCHANGE_RATES) → balance check → banking_info required. Order is correct so users get the most informative error first.
USD→EUR conversion uses EXCHANGE_RATES.get('EUR', 0.92). The 0.92 fallback is consistent with elsewhere; good defensive default.
Floating-point tolerance (max_eur + 0.01) is sensible for the cap comparison.
Refactor MT5TradingSuite.jsx (160L) + ReserveInvestmentModal.jsx (177L) is correct in size; both properly extracted. Re-export from MT5HubSections.jsx preserves back-compat.
WithdrawPage.jsx fetches /partial-unlock/status for unlockMaxEur — good single source of truth (matches backend snapshot).

Minor: consider adding a unit-level assertion in the frontend that indicator shows the *locked* variant when unlockMaxEur is null (covered in iteration_35 regression, but worth a data-testid state attribute for future tests).

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 withdraw-gate tests + iteration_35 partial-unlock suite still green)

seed_data_creation: Created (and tore down cleanly) by toggling users.partial_withdraw_unlocked=false in Mongo during test_A then restoring. Created 2 real withdraw transactions (1500 EUR + 1000 USD) on admin account — these are left behind in pending_tax status. Main agent may want to clean these up, or they'll stay harmlessly as pending_tax requests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin user partial_withdraw_unlocked is LEFT AT true with max_eur=30194.00 after this run. The 5 new backend tests in test_withdraw_partial_unlock_gate.py are idempotent (they toggle and restore the flag). Two small pending_tax withdraw transactions were created on admin account as part of success-path tests (1500 EUR and 1000 USD) — safe to leave or admin-approve/cancel. Frontend refactor of MT5Page is confirmed working; all 7 suite tabs click cleanly, Reserve modal opens from the new ReserveInvestmentModal.jsx file via the back-compat re-export in MT5HubSections.jsx. Pre-existing React hydration warning about <span> inside <tbody> on MT5Page is unrelated to this iteration.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All 3 shipped tasks verified green.
